verdict.rationale: The evidence never shows an AI agent or LLM step placed inside a Zap workflow, and it never mentions model choice. Zapier Agents (zapier-docs-8) are presented as standalone specialized agents, not as workflow steps. Zapier MCP is the reverse direction, where external AI clients call Zapier actions. Both are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can add AI agent or LLM steps inside a workflow, with model choice and tool use
